Thanks for sending the updated MSA and order form. Our legal team reviewed and attached a redline (GF_redline_MSA_v3.docx). Two items they flagged that we need to resolve before procurement can sign:

1) Publicity/testimonial clause: they want an explicit opt-in for press releases and a separate approval window for any quoted customer blurb.

Maya —

Appreciate the quick review and the redlines. Short responses inline:

- Publicity/testimonial: Redwood prefers a default mutual opt-in — we don't want automatic press releases. A 7-business-day approval window for quotes and press releases is reasonable; our product marketing team typically asks for 3 business days but can accept 7 for enterprise customers. We will propose the following compromise language: Customer must respond to Redwood's written request for approval within 7 business days; silence = no consent (explicit opt-in).

- Logo use: we can accept a narrowed permission limited to "logo placement on vendor/customer reference pages and sales collateral that does not imply endorsement," with a required pre-publication sign-off for press/joint announcements. We cannot give unlimited rights for use in partner co-branded campaigns without a separate agreement.

I'll loop in Karthik for procurement/discount implications and Dev for any product mentions in the testimonial language.

Grace O'Connor
